description:
Deletes an issue security level.

This operation is [asynchronous](#async). Follow the `location` link in the response to determine the status of the task and use [Get task](#api-rest-api-3-task-taskId-get) to obtain subsequent updates.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the issue security scheme.
parameters.name: schemeId

parameters.description: The ID of the issue security level to remove.
parameters.name: levelId

parameters.description: The ID of the issue security level that will replace the currently selected level.
parameters.name: replaceWith

303.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: "You can't delete an issue security scheme if any projects are associated with it."

400.description: Returned if the request isn't valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["You are not authorized to perform this action. Administrator privileges are required."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user doesn't have the necessary permission.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Issue security scheme with ID 10000 not found."],"errors":{}}

404.description: Returned if the issue security level isn't found.

409.description: Returned if a task to remove the issue security level is already running.
